limitations: Catalog count, provider active-asset count, priced sample size, exchange count and venue-pair coverage are distinct denominators.

Four pages sorted by market cap were requested sequentially. Rankings can move during collection; duplicate provider IDs were reconciled by observation time. This is not a simultaneous top-1000 snapshot.
USD aggregated prices and volumes are separate from named-exchange USDT data; no symbol-only identity merge is performed.
Market cap and its change are valuations, not measured cash inflows. Volume is gross trading activity.
Stablecoin supplyUsd is USD-valued circulating supply across all peg types. Its change is not proof of new fiat investment or purchases of a given token.
Chain TVL is protocol locked-asset value, affected by market prices and methodology; TVL changes are not net asset inflows.
Datasets have independent observation times. This is a saved snapshot; no scheduled refresh or wallet-owner attribution is implied.
Chain lists join only on exact DefiLlama chain names. Missing TVL or stablecoin coverage is null, not zero.
